title: SCADA Outputs Configuration
description: List of measurements published to the SCADA, by Dynawo or by the asset simulator. A subset of the game master outputs: only what the cyber mapping carries

factor.description: Scaling factor from Dynawo units to raw units (MW, kV, Hz) (value published in raw units). Defaults to 1

source.description: Cyber node from which the measurement will be sent

destination.description: Cyber node to which the measurement will be sent

period.description: Periodicity of publishing in seconds (default = simulator period)

period_offset.description: Offset to the publishing period (default = random value in [0, period[)

simulator.description: Simulator this entry belongs to; the orchestrator only drives the dynawo ones
